# Marketrends – LLM Context

> Marketrends is a Norwegian AI-powered news aggregation platform covering finance,
> technology, crypto, and market trends. Articles are ingested from 20+ RSS feeds,
> rewritten by an AI pipeline, and published automatically in Norwegian.

## Dynamic context endpoint (always up-to-date)

The following URL returns a complete, live project overview including database stats,
feed status, and recent articles – updated on every request:

```
https://jsfzdlgfxvnlosrsafjw.supabase.co/functions/v1/project-context
```

Paste this URL into any LLM chat (GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) to instantly
provide full context about the project architecture, tech stack, content categories,
pipeline logic, and current live statistics.

## Quick reference

- Live site: https://marketrends.no
- Repository: https://github.com/openorway/marketrends
- Lovable project: https://lovable.dev/projects/ed73ad9f-43df-4ba1-986e-155671257f39
- Supabase project: https://supabase.com/dashboard/project/jsfzdlgfxvnlosrsafjw
- RSS feed: https://jsfzdlgfxvnlosrsafjw.supabase.co/functions/v1/export-rss?format=rss
- JSON feed: https://jsfzdlgfxvnlosrsafjw.supabase.co/functions/v1/export-rss?format=json

## Tech stack

- React 18 + TypeScript + Vite 5
- shadcn/ui + Radix UI + Tailwind CSS
- Supabase (PostgreSQL + Deno Edge Functions)
- React Router v6 + TanStack Query v5
- Hosted on Lovable.dev (auto-deploys from GitHub)

## Content categories

- Krypto & Trading
- Teknologi & AI
- Finans & Marked
- Gründer & Startups
- Penger & Karriere
- Trender & Analyse
- Guider & Forklart
